proved_scope.exact_cancellation: The full native squarefree rational projection equals the original rational Mobius unit. High minus projected high equals projected low minus original low.
proved_scope.projected_low: Every finite N,T with H>0, cubic chi and all finite prime amplifiers; explicit divisor and rescaled-variation budgets, then a uniform subpower bound.
proved_scope.physical: N=4D,T=D, every H,D>0 and Schwartz f. Both rational unit minus projected high and original high minus projected high have the displayed target-sized norm bound.
proved_scope.small_cases: D=1, empty companion sums and all positive dilations retained. Empty rescaled prefixes are controlled by the Schwartz supremum seminorm.
proved_scope.exceptional_primes: No exclusion of 2 or 3 and no primitivity hypothesis. Character zeros at nonunits, all primes in G and all depletion masks remain in the exact formulas.

parameter_domain: For every eps>0 an absolute C_eps>0, all nonzero q, all Dirichlet chi modulo q with chi^3=1, every finite prime set G, every H,D>0 and every complex Schwartz f. Explicit factor (3q)^2*S(f)^2*(4HD)^eps.

explicit_costs.window: S(f)=Schwartz seminorm(0,0)(f)+8*schwartzLipschitzConstant(f). A varying compensated f_D retains S(f_D)^2; uniformity in that budget must be checked before a scale-uniform specialization.
explicit_costs.main_term: The signed projected high core is never replaced by a norm or unsigned coefficient mass.
explicit_costs.low_remainder: Squarefree character cancellation is applied only to the isolated low remainder; tau(n) caps include every n<=H*N^2.
explicit_costs.scope: Finite rational-input cutoff. This does not constrain the separate dual Gauss frequency m=a^6 or establish the full unbounded Abel passage.

detector_error: Unchanged; exact finite coefficient recovery preserves the original rational observable.
family_adapter: The actual rational Mobius/native hyperbola dictionary and complete original product amplifier are used. No new prime-sampled or growing-cutoff family transfer is asserted.
uncancelled_main_terms: The squarefree projected high packet, including both signed native coefficients, all character phases and compensation cross terms.
low_estimate_provenance: Existing nonprincipal squarefree companion harmonic estimate, the actual nonprincipal cubic companion, divisor-card subpowers, and a newly proved reciprocal-square-root hyperbola sum.
attainable_endpoint: This component is at exponent3/2. A response D^(2beta) with beta>3/4 survives it for fixed q,H and bounded window budget. The remaining projected high estimate and physical/Abel consumers are still required for any boundary improvement.
benchmark_status: Unconditional finite-packet component estimate compiled and focused-axiom-audited; complete exponent unchanged.
old_bound: Complete I exponent 7/4 and boundary 7/8; no maintained separate target-sized bound for the nonsquarefree rational high contribution.
new_bound: Norm of the nonsquarefree rational high contribution is at most C_eps*(3q)^2*S(f)^2*(4HD)^eps*(4D)*sqrt(D). Complete I exponent remains 7/4 and boundary 7/8.
